1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable line height, and the monospace log panel is also legible.

2.why: Instructions such as 'Enter the delivered six-digit code.' are sentence-case with no italics or dense paragraphs; only the brand label 'NORTHSTAR BANK' is all-caps.

3.why: Content sits in a single narrow centred column with large text and full-width buttons, which reads well at phone width.

4.why: Every instruction is one or two short plain-language sentences, e.g. 'Store these codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used once.'

5.why: Only the recovery-code field shows a format placeholder ('ABCDE-FGHIJ'); the email, phone, verification-code and authenticator-code fields show no example of expected input.

6.why: No screen requires reading a long passage to proceed; the growing Logs panel is supplementary and never mandatory.

7.why: No copy buttons are provided, so the manual secret and delivered codes must be transcribed by hand into the authenticator app and the input fields.

8.why: The authenticator setup offers only a plain-text manual secret; no QR code or equivalent alternative appears at any step.

9.why: Codes are delivered via an in-page Logs panel rather than SMS or email, so one-time-code autofill and password managers have nothing to hook into, and no autocomplete affordances are visible.

10.why: Each screen has a bold step heading and a filled blue primary button, though the dashboard's two identical blue buttons slightly dilute which action is primary.

11.why: Most screens request a single action, but the authenticator step bundles generating a secret, adding it to an app and entering a code, and the dashboard presents verify, regenerate and log out together.

12.why: Success states plainly report outcomes ('Recovery code accepted. Remaining unused codes: 7.'), but the error banner 'We could not complete that request.' neither explains what happened nor what to do next.

13.why: There are no reveal/hide toggles and no resend/re-request buttons for the verification or authenticator codes; only recovery-code regeneration is offered after enrolment.

14.why: The only observed error message, 'We could not complete that request.', is blame-free but states neither the problem nor how to fix it.

15.why: Reading is untimed, but the authenticator code explicitly expires ('expires at 19:55:30'), giving only a short TOTP window to enter it while the other codes have no visible limit.
